hero.kicker: The most important page on this website
hero.headline: Nan
hero.blurb: We have made this page bigger and simpler than everyone else's, because we love you and because you told us the last website was 'all tiny'.

menu.intro: Three courses. Pick one from each. If you would rather just tell us on the phone, do that instead — this is not a test.

options.label: Beef, slow cooked and very tender

sections.title: Getting you there
sections.body: You are not organising any of this. A car is booked to collect you at 11:30am from the house and to take you home whenever you have had enough. The driver's name is Tom and he has your number.

sections.title: Where you'll be sitting
sections.body: Front row for the ceremony, on the aisle, with a chair that has a proper back on it. Table 1 for dinner, next to the people you actually like.

faq.q: How long is the standing bit?
faq.a: About ten minutes in total, and there is a seat within reach at every point.

faq.q: What if I need to leave early?
faq.a: Then you leave early and nobody minds. Tom is on call from 6pm.

privateNotes: Print this page and post it to her as well. She will use the website, but she will trust the paper.

adminMeta.known dietary: Soft food preferred for the main.
